entries.en: The philosopher described goodness as immanent in ordinary human relationships.
entries.zh: 这位哲学家把善描述为内在于普通人际关系之中的东西。

entries.en: The essay contrasts spiritual aspirations with corporeal needs such as hunger.
entries.zh: 这篇文章把精神追求与饥饿等身体需求作了对比。

entries.en: The shop sells sportswear designed for running in cold weather.
entries.zh: 这家商店出售为寒冷天气下跑步设计的运动服装。

entries.en: We turned the spare bedroom into a playroom for the children.
entries.zh: 我们把闲置的卧室改成了孩子们的游戏室。

entries.en: The engineer checked the rocket's propellant tanks before the test.
entries.zh: 工程师在测试前检查了火箭的推进剂储箱。

entries.en: Closing the library to save money would be a myopic decision.
entries.zh: 为了省钱而关闭图书馆会是一个目光短浅的决定。

entries.en: A skilled bricklayer repaired the damaged wall beside the garden.
entries.zh: 一位熟练的砌砖工人修好了花园旁损坏的墙。

entries.en: The ceremony was intended to sanctify the newly built chapel.
entries.zh: 这场仪式旨在使新建的小教堂成为神圣之所。

entries.en: The rambunctious puppies chased each other around the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 这些闹腾的小狗围着厨房餐桌互相追逐。

entries.meaningZh: 一夫一妻制；单一伴侣关系
entries.en: The sociology seminar examined changing attitudes towards marriage and monogamy.
entries.zh: 社会学研讨课考察了人们对婚姻及单一伴侣关系态度的变化。

entries.en: Don't dawdle over breakfast, or you will miss the bus.
entries.zh: 吃早饭别磨蹭，否则你会赶不上公共汽车。

entries.meaningZh: 学校或修道院等的公共食堂
entries.en: Students gathered in the college refectory after the morning lecture.
entries.zh: 上午的讲座结束后，学生们聚集在学院食堂。

entries.en: The player asked for leniency after arriving late for training.
entries.zh: 这名球员训练迟到后请求从轻处理。

entries.en: The report compared two analgesics used in the study.
entries.zh: 报告比较了研究中使用的两种止痛药。

entries.en: Increasing infirmity made the steep stairs difficult for him to manage.
entries.zh: 身体日渐衰弱使他难以爬上陡峭的楼梯。

entries.en: The invaders tried to subjugate the region through military force.
entries.zh: 入侵者试图通过武力征服这个地区。

entries.meaningZh: 不容推翻的；牢不可破的
entries.en: We need an ironclad guarantee that the files will remain private.
entries.zh: 我们需要一个牢不可破的保证，确保这些文件会保持私密。

entries.en: Our French teacher began the lesson with a short dictation.
entries.zh: 法语老师以一小段听写开始了这节课。

entries.en: A stone colossus once stood at the entrance to the palace.
entries.zh: 宫殿入口处曾矗立着一尊巨大的石像。

entries.en: A tall obelisk marks the centre of the public square.
entries.zh: 一座高大的方尖碑标示着公共广场的中心。

entries.meaningZh: 被视为异端的；违背正统教义的
entries.en: Religious authorities at the time condemned the book as heretical.
entries.zh: 当时的宗教当局谴责这本书违背正统教义。

entries.en: Her interest in bacteria led her to study microbiology at university.
entries.zh: 对细菌的兴趣促使她在大学学习微生物学。

entries.en: The tiny bead was no larger than a pinhead.
entries.zh: 那颗小珠子不比大头针的针帽大。

entries.en: Unexpected questions can fluster even a well-prepared speaker.
entries.zh: 出乎意料的问题甚至会让准备充分的演讲者慌乱。

entries.en: The detective suspected trickery when both witnesses told identical stories.
entries.zh: 两名证人讲出完全相同的故事时，侦探怀疑其中有诈。

entries.en: The debate collapsed into personal invective instead of reasoned argument.
entries.zh: 这场辩论沦为了人身辱骂，而不是讲道理的讨论。

entries.en: Repeated booking errors exposed the agency's administrative ineptitude.
entries.zh: 反复出现的预订错误暴露了这家机构行政管理上的无能。

entries.en: Her indomitable spirit kept the volunteer team working through the storm.
entries.zh: 她不屈不挠的精神让志愿者团队在暴风雨中坚持工作。

entries.meaningZh: 静止不动；无法移动的状态
entries.en: The actor's complete immobility made the final scene strangely unsettling.
entries.zh: 演员完全静止不动，让最后一幕显得异样地令人不安。

entries.meaningZh: 使吸收水分；使充分吸水
entries.en: The dried beans need time to hydrate before they are cooked.
entries.zh: 这些干豆子在烹煮前需要时间充分吸水。

entries.en: Workers lowered the floodgate as the river began to rise.
entries.zh: 河水开始上涨时，工人们放下了防洪闸。

entries.en: The weather here is so changeable that I always carry a jacket.
entries.zh: 这里的天气变化无常，所以我总带着一件夹克。

entries.en: The pedestrian path runs beneath the overpass beside the railway.
entries.zh: 这条人行道从铁路旁的跨线桥下穿过。

entries.en: She finds cruelty to animals abhorrent and supports local shelters.
entries.zh: 她认为虐待动物令人憎恶，并支持当地的动物收容所。

entries.en: You can abbreviate September to Sept. in this table.
entries.zh: 在这张表里，你可以把 September 缩写成 Sept.。

entries.en: The report's turgid prose made a simple proposal difficult to understand.
entries.zh: 这份报告浮夸晦涩的文字让一个简单的提议变得难以理解。

entries.en: Wash the wool sweater gently to reduce the risk of shrinkage.
entries.zh: 轻柔地清洗这件羊毛衫，以减少缩水的风险。

entries.en: The soup was insipid until she added herbs and a little salt.
entries.zh: 在她加入香草和少许盐之前，这道汤味道寡淡。

entries.en: Two spectators were removed after a fracas near the stadium gate.
entries.zh: 体育场门口附近发生一场喧闹的冲突后，两名观众被带离。

entries.en: We photographed a starfish clinging to a rock in the pool.
entries.zh: 我们拍下了一只附着在水潭岩石上的海星。

entries.en: His erudite lecture connected medieval poetry with modern ideas about memory.
entries.zh: 他那场展现博学的讲座把中世纪诗歌与现代记忆观念联系起来。

entries.en: Dappled sunlight fell across the path beneath the trees.
entries.zh: 斑驳的阳光洒在树下的小路上。

entries.en: A quiet piano coda brought the final movement to an end.
entries.zh: 一段轻柔的钢琴尾声为最后一个乐章画上了句号。

entries.en: It was unselfish of you to give up your seat.
entries.zh: 你让出自己的座位，真是无私。

entries.meaningZh: 被轻蔑地称作乌合之众的人群
entries.en: The mayor dismissed the peaceful protesters as a noisy rabble.
entries.zh: 市长把和平示威者轻蔑地说成一群吵闹的乌合之众。

entries.en: The saleswoman helped me choose a coat for the winter.
entries.zh: 这位女售货员帮我挑了一件冬天穿的外套。

entries.en: After a brief digression about trains, he returned to the main topic.
entries.zh: 他短暂地离题谈了谈火车，随后回到了正题。

entries.meaningZh: 暗中共谋；纵容不当行为
entries.en: The accountant refused to connive at the manager's dishonest practices.
entries.zh: 会计拒绝纵容经理的不诚实行为。

entries.meaningZh: 含有粗俗性笑话的；荤的
entries.en: The comedian replaced his bawdy jokes with material suitable for children.
entries.zh: 这名喜剧演员把荤笑话换成了适合儿童的内容。

entries.en: The historical exhibition included a drawing of the prison gallows.
entries.zh: 这场历史展览展出了一幅监狱绞刑架的画。

entries.en: The rebellion ended decades of subjection to a distant ruler.
entries.zh: 这场起义结束了数十年来受远方统治者支配的状态。

entries.en: She drained the pasta in a colander over the sink.
entries.zh: 她用放在水槽上方的滤盆沥干了意大利面。

entries.en: Readers praised the translation for its faithfulness to the original tone.
entries.zh: 读者们赞扬这份译文忠实保留了原作的语气。

entries.en: The lack of funding proved an insuperable obstacle to the project.
entries.zh: 缺乏资金成了这个项目无法克服的障碍。

entries.en: The address was almost illegible because rain had blurred the ink.
entries.zh: 雨水晕开了墨迹，地址几乎无法辨认。

entries.en: A crane lifted the steel girder into position above the road.
entries.zh: 起重机把钢梁吊到了道路上方的指定位置。

entries.en: We covered the firewood with a tarpaulin before the rain began.
entries.zh: 下雨前，我们用防水篷布盖住了木柴。

entries.en: Her review was thoughtful rather than moralistic about the characters' mistakes.
entries.zh: 她的评论认真分析了人物的错误，而没有作道德说教。

entries.meaningZh: 不同生物之间的共生关系
entries.en: The diagram illustrates symbiosis between a fungus and an alga.
entries.zh: 这张图展示了一种真菌与一种藻类之间的共生关系。

entries.en: The museum displayed the helmet of a Roman gladiator.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一名古罗马角斗士的头盔。

entries.en: White sails dotted the azure sea beyond the harbour.
entries.zh: 港口外蔚蓝的海面上点缀着白帆。

entries.en: I use a stylus to draw precise lines on the tablet.
entries.zh: 我用触控笔在平板电脑上画精确的线条。

entries.en: The council voted to annul the earlier decision about parking fees.
entries.zh: 委员会投票决定撤销先前有关停车费的决定。

entries.en: His letter expressed genuine contrition for the harm he had caused.
entries.zh: 他的信对自己造成的伤害表达了真诚的悔恨。

entries.en: All delegates attended the plenary session on the conference's final morning.
entries.zh: 所有代表都参加了会议最后一天上午的全体会议。

entries.meaningZh: 炼狱；天主教教义中的灵魂净化之境
entries.en: The lecture examined depictions of purgatory in medieval religious paintings.
entries.zh: 讲座探讨了中世纪宗教绘画中对炼狱的描绘。

entries.en: Road closures forced us to take a circuitous route home.
entries.zh: 道路封闭迫使我们绕远路回家。

entries.en: The child built a tiny bridge from a box of matchsticks.
entries.zh: 这个孩子用一盒火柴搭了一座小桥。

entries.en: Her vivacious manner soon put the nervous guests at ease.
entries.zh: 她活泼开朗的举止很快让紧张的客人放松下来。

entries.en: He regretted posting a vitriolic reply during the online argument.
entries.zh: 他后悔在网上争论时发了一条尖刻恶毒的回复。

entries.meaningZh: 空洞无物的；缺乏思想的
entries.en: The speech offered vacuous slogans instead of practical solutions.
entries.zh: 这场演讲给出的只是空洞的口号，而非实际的解决办法。

entries.en: She was magnanimous in victory and warmly praised her opponent.
entries.zh: 她获胜后表现得宽宏大量，热情地赞扬了对手。

entries.meaningZh: 随意议论；把想法或说法传来传去
entries.en: We bandied several names about but made no final choice.
entries.zh: 我们随意讨论了几个名字，但没有作出最终选择。

entries.meaningZh: 神权政体；由宗教权威统治的国家
entries.en: The novel depicts a theocracy governed by a council of priests.
entries.zh: 这部小说描写了一个由祭司议会统治的神权国家。

entries.meaningZh: 使变成性质不同的东西
entries.en: The poet transmuted a painful memory into a moving song.
entries.zh: 这位诗人把一段痛苦的回忆化作了一首动人的歌。

entries.meaningZh: 没有遮挡的；畅通无阻的
entries.en: From the balcony we had an unobstructed view of the mountains.
entries.zh: 从阳台望去，群山尽收眼底，没有任何遮挡。

entries.en: The chemistry class examined how cellulose forms part of plant cell walls.
entries.zh: 化学课探讨了纤维素如何构成植物细胞壁的一部分。

entries.en: Clear skies provided propitious conditions for the outdoor concert.
entries.zh: 晴朗的天空为户外音乐会提供了有利条件。

entries.en: After shouting all evening, he answered in a raspy voice.
entries.zh: 喊了一整晚后，他用沙哑的声音作答。

entries.en: The coach used a stopwatch to time each swimmer's final lap.
entries.zh: 教练用秒表记录了每位游泳者最后一圈的用时。

entries.en: Her grandparents dote on her and keep every picture she draws.
entries.zh: 她的祖父母十分宠爱她，把她画的每一幅画都留着。

entries.en: Warm the wax gently until it becomes soft and pliable.
entries.zh: 轻轻加热蜡，直到它变得柔软可塑。

entries.en: His unexpected impression of the headmaster caused general hilarity.
entries.zh: 他出人意料地模仿校长，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

entries.en: The caretaker greeted new residents with an avuncular smile.
entries.zh: 管理员带着像慈祥叔伯般和蔼的笑容迎接新住户。

entries.en: The map shows where travellers can obtain potable water.
entries.zh: 地图标出了旅行者可以获取饮用水的地点。

entries.en: The old photograph had faded to a pale brownish colour.
entries.zh: 那张旧照片已经褪成了浅浅的棕褐色。

entries.en: Staff disinfect the shared equipment after each laboratory session.
entries.zh: 每次实验课后，工作人员都会给共用设备消毒。

entries.en: There was jubilation in the stadium when the final whistle blew.
entries.zh: 终场哨声响起时，体育场里一片欢腾。

entries.en: An ancient aqueduct carried water across the valley to the town.
entries.zh: 一座古代渡槽把水输送过山谷，送到城镇。

entries.en: The firefighter received a medal for gallantry during the rescue.
entries.zh: 这名消防员因救援中的英勇表现获得了一枚奖章。

entries.en: I slipped a bookmark between the pages before closing the novel.
entries.zh: 合上小说前，我在书页间夹了一张书签。

entries.en: The dancers made synchronous movements to the steady drumbeat.
entries.zh: 舞者们伴着平稳的鼓点作出同步动作。

entries.en: This colloquial expression sounds natural in conversation but informal in essays.
entries.zh: 这个口语表达在交谈中很自然，但用在文章里显得不够正式。

entries.en: The excited pony pranced around the field with its tail raised.
entries.zh: 那匹兴奋的小马翘着尾巴，在田野里欢蹦乱跳。

entries.en: Two brawny movers carried the piano up the narrow staircase.
entries.zh: 两名强壮的搬运工把钢琴抬上了狭窄的楼梯。

entries.en: A narrow rivulet ran beside the path after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，一条细流沿着小路流淌。

entries.meaningZh: 因不如意而闹脾气的；任性的
entries.en: He gave a petulant sigh when his request was refused.
entries.zh: 请求被拒绝时，他赌气地叹了一口气。

entries.meaningZh: 把某种动机或行为归于某人
entries.en: He resented colleagues who imputed dishonest motives to him.
entries.zh: 他对那些认为他动机不诚实的同事感到不满。

entries.meaningZh: 使容易理解；揭开神秘面纱
entries.en: The workshop aims to demystify computer programming for complete beginners.
entries.zh: 这次工作坊旨在让零基础学习者也能理解计算机编程。

entries.en: The gardener tamped the soil around the newly planted tree.
entries.zh: 园丁压实了新栽树木周围的土壤。

entries.en: The railway links the inland factories with a busy seaport.
entries.zh: 这条铁路把内陆工厂与一个繁忙的海港连接起来。

entries.en: We found a videocassette of our school play in the attic.
entries.zh: 我们在阁楼里找到了一盒录着学校戏剧演出的录像带。

entries.en: My cat is finicky about food and refuses most brands.
entries.zh: 我的猫对食物很挑剔，大多数牌子都不吃。

entries.en: The villagers beseeched the officials to repair the damaged bridge.
entries.zh: 村民们恳求官员修好损坏的桥。

entries.en: The village market sells handicrafts made from local wood and wool.
entries.zh: 村里的集市出售用当地木材和羊毛制作的手工艺品。

entries.en: After retiring, the writer became a recluse in a coastal cottage.
entries.zh: 退休后，这位作家在海边的小屋里过起了隐居生活。

entries.meaningZh: 以金条或银条等形式储存的贵金属
entries.en: The vault contained gold bullion packed in numbered wooden crates.
entries.zh: 金库里存放着装在编号木箱中的金条。

entries.en: The novel explores the depravity hidden beneath the ruler's respectable image.
entries.zh: 这部小说探讨了统治者体面形象下隐藏的道德败坏。

entries.en: He hung his dripping mackintosh on a hook by the door.
entries.zh: 他把滴着水的雨衣挂在门边的钩子上。

entries.meaningZh: 可恶的；讨厌透顶的，表示恼怒
entries.en: That infernal alarm has been ringing since six this morning.
entries.zh: 那个该死的闹钟从今天早上六点就一直在响。

entries.en: They spent several days on a transcontinental train journey.
entries.zh: 他们花了几天时间乘火车横穿大陆。

entries.en: A dark blotch of ink spread across the notebook page.
entries.zh: 一大片深色墨斑在笔记本的书页上晕开。

entries.en: Her research in demography focuses on migration and ageing populations.
entries.zh: 她的人口学研究主要关注移民和人口老龄化。

entries.meaningZh: 被视为男性气概或精力旺盛的特质
entries.en: The essay questions advertisements that equate physical strength with virility.
entries.zh: 这篇文章质疑了那些把体力等同于男性气概的广告。

entries.meaningZh: 神经病学；研究神经系统及其疾病的医学分支
entries.en: She chose neurology because she wanted to understand the nervous system.
entries.zh: 她选择了神经病学，因为她想了解神经系统。

entries.en: His bright velvet jacket was a surprising sartorial choice.
entries.zh: 他选择穿那件鲜艳的天鹅绒夹克，着实令人意外。

entries.meaningZh: 价格或费用高得使人难以负担地
entries.en: Hotels near the stadium became prohibitively expensive during the tournament.
entries.zh: 比赛期间，体育场附近酒店的价格高得让人难以负担。

entries.en: Her reputation for probity made her a trusted treasurer.
entries.zh: 她以正直著称，因此成为一名备受信任的财务主管。

entries.en: The smell of spoiled fish began to nauseate the passengers.
entries.zh: 腐坏鱼肉的气味开始让乘客们感到恶心。

entries.en: The palace's marble halls displayed the opulence of the royal court.
entries.zh: 宫殿的大理石厅堂展现了王室的奢华。

entries.en: An apology and a full refund helped mollify the angry customer.
entries.zh: 道歉和全额退款帮助安抚了那位愤怒的顾客。

entries.meaningZh: 容易引起反感或不满的；不公平而令人为难的
entries.en: The award created an invidious comparison between two equally talented students.
entries.zh: 这个奖项让两名同样有才华的学生被拿来比较，容易引起不满。

entries.en: Fittingly, the concert ended with a song about homecoming.
entries.zh: 这场音乐会以一首关于归家的歌结束，十分应景。

entries.en: An unearthly howl echoed through the abandoned tunnel.
entries.zh: 一阵诡异的嚎叫在废弃的隧道里回荡。

entries.en: Our resident technology maven helped everyone set up their new laptops.
entries.zh: 我们这里的技术行家帮大家设置好了新笔记本电脑。

entries.en: She handled the unexpected interruption with remarkable aplomb.
entries.zh: 她极其沉着地应对了这次意外的打断。

entries.meaningZh: 书信，尤指正式或较长的信
entries.en: A lengthy missive from the landlord arrived in the morning post.
entries.zh: 早晨的邮件里有一封房东寄来的长信。

entries.en: The story's villain is a loathsome man who betrays his friends.
entries.zh: 故事里的反派是个背叛朋友、令人厌恶的人。

entries.meaningZh: 抱有顽固偏见的；偏执排外的
entries.en: The moderator removed bigoted comments that attacked people for their religion.
entries.zh: 版主删除了那些因宗教信仰而攻击他人的偏执言论。

entries.meaningZh: 说话时用手势或身体动作表达
entries.en: He gesticulated wildly while explaining how he had missed the train.
entries.zh: 他解释自己如何错过火车时，激动地比画着。

entries.en: The packer wrapped each glass carefully before sealing the box.
entries.zh: 包装工仔细包好每个玻璃杯，然后封上箱子。

entries.en: Blaming an innocent colleague for your mistake is contemptible.
entries.zh: 把自己的错误归咎于无辜的同事是卑鄙的。

entries.meaningZh: 造成烦恼或祸患的根源
entries.en: Unreliable internet has become the bane of my working day.
entries.zh: 不稳定的网络已经成了我每天工作的烦恼之源。

entries.meaningZh: 学术院或学术团体的院士、会员
entries.en: The newly elected academician delivered a lecture on marine archaeology.
entries.zh: 这位新当选的院士作了一场关于海洋考古学的讲座。

entries.meaningZh: 在必要之处过分节省；吝于投入
entries.en: Do not skimp on preparation if you want a convincing presentation.
entries.zh: 如果想让演讲有说服力，就不要吝于做准备。

entries.meaningZh: 严厉批评；痛斥，比喻用法
entries.en: Reviewers flayed the film for its careless treatment of history.
entries.zh: 评论者痛斥这部电影对历史的处理草率。

entries.en: The despot banned public criticism and imprisoned his political opponents.
entries.zh: 这位暴君禁止公开批评，并监禁了政治对手。

entries.en: A hornet hovered near the open jar of jam.
entries.zh: 一只大黄蜂在敞开的果酱罐旁盘旋。

entries.en: Regular lubrication keeps the old sewing machine running smoothly.
entries.zh: 定期润滑让这台旧缝纫机运转顺畅。

entries.en: Their short film is a spoof of serious detective dramas.
entries.zh: 他们的短片是一部戏仿严肃侦探剧的作品。

entries.en: Tawdry plastic ornaments spoiled the elegance of the old room.
entries.zh: 廉价俗艳的塑料装饰品破坏了这间老屋的优雅感。

entries.en: A spark singed the edge of his sleeve without burning through it.
entries.zh: 一粒火星烧焦了他的袖口边缘，但没有烧穿。

entries.meaningZh: 做得过头；超出自身能力或权限
entries.en: The company overreached itself by opening too many branches at once.
entries.zh: 这家公司一次开了太多分店，超出了自身承受能力。

entries.en: The garden attracts insects that help with the pollination of fruit trees.
entries.zh: 这座花园吸引了有助于果树授粉的昆虫。

entries.en: An omniscient narrator reveals the private thoughts of every main character.
entries.zh: 一位全知叙述者揭示了每个主要人物的内心想法。

entries.meaningZh: 惹眼的；张扬而引人注目的
entries.en: The brand launched a splashy advertising campaign with enormous illuminated posters.
entries.zh: 这个品牌以巨大的灯光海报推出了一场惹眼的广告宣传活动。

entries.en: A toothache kept him awake for most of the night.
entries.zh: 牙痛让他一夜大部分时间都无法入睡。

entries.meaningZh: 下属；喽啰，常含轻蔑意味
entries.en: The arrogant manager treated every assistant as an insignificant underling.
entries.zh: 这位傲慢的经理把每个助理都当成无足轻重的小喽啰。

entries.meaningZh: 瘦高而四肢修长、动作笨拙的
entries.en: The gangly teenager struggled to fit into the small theatre seat.
entries.zh: 那个四肢修长的瘦高少年费劲地挤进了狭小的剧院座位。

entries.en: A delay in deliveries caused serious slippage in the building schedule.
entries.zh: 交货延迟导致施工进度严重拖后。

entries.meaningZh: 偏离正常或预期模式的；异常的
entries.en: The analyst checked the instrument before interpreting the aberrant readings.
entries.zh: 分析人员在解读异常读数之前检查了仪器。

entries.meaningZh: 带有激烈争辩或攻击性的
entries.en: His polemical essay attacks the assumptions behind the proposed reform.
entries.zh: 他那篇带有论战色彩的文章抨击了拟议改革背后的假设。

entries.en: The lyricist rewrote the final verse to match the new melody.
entries.zh: 歌词作者重写了最后一节歌词，以配合新的旋律。

entries.en: Former students spoke of their teacher with deep veneration.
entries.zh: 昔日的学生怀着深深的崇敬谈起他们的老师。

entries.en: The alternation of light and shadow gives the painting depth.
entries.zh: 光与影的交替使这幅画具有纵深感。

entries.meaningZh: 管道等部件上用于连接的凸缘；法兰
entries.en: The mechanic tightened the bolts around the pipe's metal flange.
entries.zh: 机械师拧紧了管道金属法兰周围的螺栓。

entries.meaningZh: 尚未表态支持某一方的；未作承诺的
entries.en: Several uncommitted voters asked both candidates for more detailed proposals.
entries.zh: 几名尚未决定支持谁的选民要求两位候选人给出更详细的提案。

entries.meaningZh: 装饰；装饰物的整体效果
entries.en: The building's plain exterior contrasts with the elaborate ornamentation inside.
entries.zh: 这座建筑朴素的外观与内部精巧繁复的装饰形成对比。

entries.en: The immensity of the desert became clear from the mountain ridge.
entries.zh: 站在山脊上，沙漠的广袤无边显露无遗。

entries.en: The wildlife documentary showed vultures gathering around carrion on the plain.
entries.zh: 这部野生动物纪录片展示了秃鹫在平原上聚集到腐肉周围。

entries.meaningZh: 宿命论；认为一切已注定的态度
entries.en: Her refusal to accept defeat challenged the community's sense of fatalism.
entries.zh: 她拒绝认输的态度挑战了这个群体听天由命的观念。

entries.meaningZh: 冒充专家行骗的人；江湖骗子
entries.en: The supposed art expert was exposed as a charlatan selling fake certificates.
entries.zh: 那个所谓的艺术专家被揭露为出售假证书的骗子。

entries.meaningZh: 长期如此地；年复一年地
entries.en: The perennially popular seaside café stays busy even during winter.
entries.zh: 这家长年受欢迎的海边咖啡馆即使在冬天也很忙。

entries.en: A row of stones demarcates the boundary between the two gardens.
entries.zh: 一排石头标明了两座花园之间的界限。

entries.meaningZh: 色彩、程度等的逐渐变化；层次
entries.en: The artist achieved a subtle gradation from pale grey to black.
entries.zh: 这位艺术家实现了从浅灰到黑色的细腻渐变。

entries.en: The service ended with a benediction spoken by the elderly priest.
entries.zh: 礼拜以那位年迈神父的祝祷结束。

entries.en: Long strands of kelp washed onto the beach after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，长长的海藻被冲上了沙滩。

entries.meaningZh: 赞美过分而令人觉得不真诚的
entries.en: His fulsome praise sounded less like admiration than an attempt to flatter.
entries.zh: 他过分的赞美听起来不像钦佩，倒像是在奉承。

entries.meaningZh: 轻松嬉闹；无关紧要的玩乐
entries.en: A little frivolity helped everyone relax after the tense meeting.
entries.zh: 紧张的会议过后，稍微嬉闹一下帮助大家放松下来。

entries.meaningZh: 势利的；自命高人一等的
entries.en: Her snobbish remarks about cheap clothes embarrassed the other guests.
entries.zh: 她对廉价衣服的势利评论让其他客人感到尴尬。

entries.en: I rashly promised to finish the entire report before lunch.
entries.zh: 我轻率地答应在午饭前完成整份报告。

entries.meaningZh: 食物厚重黏实、容易让人饱胀的
entries.en: The pudding was too stodgy for anyone to want a second helping.
entries.zh: 这道布丁太厚重黏实，谁都不想再吃一份。

entries.meaningZh: 慷慨激昂地朗诵或演说
entries.en: He stood on the stage and declaimed the poem with theatrical passion.
entries.zh: 他站在舞台上，以戏剧般的激情朗诵了这首诗。

entries.meaningZh: 某人或某物的强烈控制、吸引或束缚
entries.en: The children sat in thrall to the storyteller's dramatic voice.
entries.zh: 孩子们坐着，被讲故事者富有戏剧性的声音深深吸引。

entries.en: His obstinacy prevented him from admitting an obvious mistake.
entries.zh: 他的固执让他不肯承认一个明显的错误。

entries.en: Luxuriant ferns covered the shaded ground beside the stream.
entries.zh: 茂盛的蕨类植物覆盖着溪流旁阴凉的地面。

entries.meaningZh: 因不耐烦或受约束而躁动不安的
entries.en: The audience grew restive as the delayed performance failed to begin.
entries.zh: 迟迟未开始的演出让观众越来越不耐烦，躁动起来。

entries.meaningZh: 大量丰富的事物；丰盛的汇集
entries.en: The autumn market offered a cornucopia of apples, pumpkins and fresh bread.
entries.zh: 秋季集市上有琳琅满目的苹果、南瓜和新鲜面包。

entries.en: The village postmaster knew exactly where to deliver the misaddressed parcel.
entries.zh: 村里的邮局负责人确切知道该把那个地址写错的包裹送到哪里。

entries.en: My thrifty aunt repairs old furniture instead of buying new pieces.
entries.zh: 我节俭的姨妈会修理旧家具，而不是买新的。

entries.en: The thirsty hikers guzzled cold lemonade when they reached the café.
entries.zh: 口渴的徒步者到达咖啡馆后大口喝起了冰柠檬水。

entries.en: The teacher gently reproved him for interrupting another student.
entries.zh: 老师温和地责备他打断了另一名学生的话。

entries.meaningZh: 适应新的气候、环境或条件
entries.en: It took me several weeks to acclimate to the dry climate.
entries.zh: 我花了几个星期才适应这种干燥的气候。

entries.meaningZh: 学识渊博的人；某领域的学者
entries.en: The visiting savant spoke with remarkable insight about ancient languages.
entries.zh: 这位来访的学者对古代语言发表了极有见地的看法。

entries.meaningZh: 抚慰；缓解内疚等不安情绪
entries.en: He donated the money to salve his conscience after breaking his promise.
entries.zh: 违背承诺后，他捐出这笔钱，想让自己的良心好受些。

entries.en: She brushed a patch of lint from her dark jacket.
entries.zh: 她刷掉了深色夹克上的一片绒毛。

entries.en: The historian studied conjugal life through the couple's surviving letters.
entries.zh: 这位历史学家通过那对夫妻留存的书信研究他们的婚姻生活。

entries.en: The speaker stepped onto the rostrum and adjusted the microphone.
entries.zh: 演讲者走上讲台，调整了麦克风。

entries.meaningZh: 可能犯错的；并非绝对可靠的
entries.en: Even experienced editors are fallible, so every article receives another check.
entries.zh: 即使经验丰富的编辑也可能犯错，所以每篇文章都会再检查一次。

entries.en: The children practised subtraction by taking counters away from a pile.
entries.zh: 孩子们从一堆计数片中拿走一些，以此练习减法。

entries.en: He hummed a cheerful ditty while sweeping the kitchen floor.
entries.zh: 他一边扫厨房地板，一边哼着一首欢快的小曲。

entries.en: Her skill at mimicry made every character in the story sound distinct.
entries.zh: 她擅长模仿，让故事中每个人物的声音都各具特色。

entries.meaningZh: 愚蠢而自以为是的；空洞无聊的
entries.en: His fatuous suggestion ignored every practical difficulty we had discussed.
entries.zh: 他那个愚蠢的建议无视了我们讨论过的所有实际困难。

entries.en: After a fitful night's sleep, she woke feeling unusually tired.
entries.zh: 断断续续地睡了一夜后，她醒来时觉得格外疲惫。

entries.en: The vet explained why they needed to medicate the injured horse.
entries.zh: 兽医解释了为什么需要用药物治疗那匹受伤的马。

entries.en: We discovered a moldy loaf of bread behind the cereal boxes.
entries.zh: 我们在麦片盒后面发现了一条发霉的面包。

entries.meaningZh: 头发或衣着凌乱的，美式拼写
entries.en: He arrived disheveled after cycling through the wind and rain.
entries.zh: 他顶着风雨骑车赶到，头发衣着都凌乱不堪。

entries.en: The workers sluiced the muddy yard with water from a hose.
entries.zh: 工人们用水管里的水冲洗了泥泞的院子。

entries.meaningZh: 螺旋钻；钻孔用的螺旋工具
entries.en: The carpenter used an auger to bore holes in the beam.
entries.zh: 木匠用螺旋钻在梁上钻孔。

entries.en: In the photograph, her injured arm was supported by a splint.
entries.zh: 照片里，她受伤的手臂由夹板固定支撑着。
